Tooltip_GS_TerminalReader: Reads whatever the disk tells it to and nothing else. No questions asked, no judgement about your pre-apocalypse life choices.
Tooltip_GS_ReaderCasing: The shell that stops the rest of the parts from quitting after the first drop. Recycled sheet metal, undamaged pride.
Tooltip_GS_ReaderCircuit: The reader's brain. Doesn't know there are zombies outside, and honestly, happier that way.
Tooltip_GS_ReaderAntenna: Picks up the SiK network signal from across the room. From across the county, don't push your luck.
Tooltip_GS_FloppyDisk: 1.44 MB of software that survived the apocalypse better than most people did.
Tooltip_GS_FloppyDisk_Blank: Unformatted, unlabeled, and full of potential. Whatever ends up on it is entirely your doing.
Tooltip_GS_FloppyDisk_Uninstall: One program, one purpose: politely evicting a SiK terminal from whatever it's plugged into.
Tooltip_GS_PC_Tower: A metal box shaped like a box. Everything useful happens inside it.
Tooltip_GS_Motherboard: Holds every other part of the computer together and never gets a thank you.
Tooltip_GS_IODevice: Translates buttons and cables into something the computer understands. A quiet little polyglot.
Tooltip_GS_Keyboard: Plenty of keys for typing passwords nobody's ever going to check again.
Tooltip_GS_Manual_TerminalUnit: "GS Network Monthly": the only magazine still publishing on schedule, even with no one left to deliver it.
Tooltip_GS_Manual_PCBuild: "Home Computing Digest": build your own PC from spare parts and a blind faith in twenty-year-old electronics.
Tooltip_GS_Manual_DiskPrograms: "GS Disk Utilities": step-by-step instructions for writing a program onto a blank disk. Requires standing close enough to a terminal to bother.
Tooltip_GS_FloppyDisk_DriveInstall: One program, one purpose: teaching a terminal to keep its own Floppy Drive plugged in, so it doesn't have to ride in your pockets anymore.
Tooltip_GS_Manual_DriveInstall_DiskProgr: "GS Disk Tools": step-by-step instructions for writing the disk that installs the Floppy Drive into a terminal's network. Requires standing close enough to a terminal to bother.
Tooltip_GS_Manual_NetworkDisk_DiskProgra: "GS Disk Tools": step-by-step instructions for writing the disk that carries the GS network's own operating system. Requires standing close enough to a terminal to bother.
Tooltip_GS_Manual_SolderingIron: A scrappy DIY guide to building your own soldering iron out of scavenged parts. Reading it alone won't get you anywhere - somebody has to actually allow this shortcut first.
